title: Native FMC root-withdrawal composite-state update oracle retrieval checkpoint

predecessor.D26: Root-uptake authority reconciled; total uptake is comparable but spatial sink semantics are structurally different.
predecessor.D27: Synthetic unstressed total-uptake finite-volume accounting passes with exact SWAP-vs-FMC total uptake identity and explicit spatial non-equivalence.
predecessor.implication: The remaining authority gap is not total water accounting. It is the native composite FMC state update when root extraction intersects surface fronts, falling slugs and/or groundwater fronts.

primary_paper_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method, Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
explicit_statements: potential transpiration demand is calculated before root-zone withdrawal
water is removed from the right-most water-containing bin in the specified root zone until demand is met
root uptake can remove water from surface wetting fronts, falling slugs and groundwater fronts if those states occupy the root zone
finite-volume water movement/removal is the mass-conservation authority
insufficient_for_native_composite_update: does not specify an unambiguous update ordering when the selected right-most bin is represented simultaneously in multiple disjoint FMC geometric state components
does not fully specify how partially exhausted root-zone occupancy is redistributed across surface-front, slug and groundwater-front representations after withdrawal
does not provide enough prose detail to reproduce the authors' eight-month ET state evolution without inventing implementation semantics
primary_paper_authority.conclusion: The paper is sufficient for process identity and D27 synthetic accounting, but not for a faithful native composite root-active trajectory implementation.

external_oracle.reported_contents: authors' C code plus the eight-month Panama rainfall/ET loam case

allowed_next_when_source_becomes_availab: verify archive provenance against M2WC70 repository metadata and record an immutable archive digest
inspect only the root-zone uptake and composite state-update routines needed to disambiguate surface-front, falling-slug and groundwater-front withdrawal semantics
write a clean-room equations/state-transition specification without copying external source code into SWAP5
preregister a native FMC wet/no-stress root-active trajectory before execution
only after a wet/no-stress trajectory closes may drought stress and seasonal ET be proposed
stopping_condition: Current F-ROMV2 research stops here until the external M2WC70 implementation oracle or an equally authoritative source becomes retrievable. This is an external source-authority blocker, not a request for an ungoverned modeling choice.
